title: Whispering Whirligig Whelk
statement: A pearly spiral-shelled snail the size of a teacup, it glides in slow loops around a drowned lighthouse lamp, trailing ribbons of glowing plankton that hum like a faint lullaby whenever the current shifts. The tank is a hushed indigo dusk of swaying kelp, moss-furred stones and one tilted brass lantern, where the whelk keeps its patient, lopsided watch over the dark.
